observations.pairA_difference: Corner radius: D6B1 has larger/more rounded corners; 72E4 has smaller/less rounded corners (sharper corners)
observations.pairB_difference: Corner radius: A83F has larger/more rounded corners; 5C09 has smaller/less rounded corners (sharper corners)
observations.position_same: Yes - both versions in each pair are at the same position and size
observations.content_lost: No - all text and elements are present in both versions of each pair

why.pairA: 72E4's sharper corners create a harder edge that feels integrated with the screen's top boundary, whereas D6B1's rounded corners make it appear as a separate floating widget. For a surface whose top edge IS the screen edge, the sharper corner treatment (72E4) demonstrates more intentional craft for this specific positioning constraint.
why.pairB: 5C09's smaller corner radius makes the panel feel like it belongs to and extends from the screen edge, while A83F's rounder corners suggest a separate floating interface element. The sharper treatment shows more deliberate design for screen-edge placement and achieves the goal of integration rather than separation.
